name: Houthis (Yemen)
summary: Houthis, Day 228. The group now fights a two-front calibrated war: against Saudi Arabia it has escalated to the top rung — mass-casualty strikes on civil airports (KKIA Riyadh attacked on five days and hit on four, 6–12 Oct; 13 dead on 10 Oct incl. an American and an Indian; GACA 20 dead/356 injured), claimed hits on Aramco plants (Riyadh refinery fire seen by AFP; Shedgum/Tanajib unconfirmed), and a Medina power-station strike the coalition attributes by wreckage — while it exempts Mecca and Medina airports in public. Against everyone else it keeps the pledge: 32 days without a UKMTO-verified attack on a non-Saudi hull since the Perim seizure; container lines are adding Suez services and neutral war-risk fell to 0.2–0.3%. Riyadh's answer — Sanaa strikes from 1 Oct, the Mecca Pact activated 5 Oct, a Saudi-directed ground offensive from 5 Oct — has not retaken Perim/Mayun and lost ground at Taiz. The hinge is Washington: Trump says 'We may' join strikes; Bukhaiti promises a 'swift and painful' response against US interests if it does. The graph's reading: the Bab el-Mandeb is Saudi-specific leverage held in reserve; a US strike is the event most likely to convert it to all-flags.

recent_signals.headline: **Bab el-Mandeb still open to neutral hulls — no UKMTO-verified Houthi attack on a non-Saudi merchant ship in 32 days; Krieg's 14-day test expired ~25 Sep UNFIRED.** ACLED (1 Oct): 'no corroborated maritime attacks since 24 August'; 10 ships attacked 13 Jul–25 Sep, 7 Saudi-flagged/owned; 'calibrated coercion'. One unattributed near-miss: Marshall Is. tanker *Chrystal Sky* reported explosions ~60nm south of Mokha on 4 Oct (UKMTO 151-26; no damage; possible spillover from coastal fighting). Container lines ADDED Suez services (Gemini AE5/AE11/ME2; MSC partial); neutral Red Sea war-risk 0.2–0.3% vs Saudi-linked 3–7% (Reuters 25 Sep) — the insurance market prices the pledge as credible. Coalition 'Dawn of Yemen' has not retaken Mayun/Perim (AFP 10 Oct); Houthis advanced at Taiz (all four exits, 12 Oct). No Houthi launch at Israel since 8–9 June. — absence REPORTED; offensive CONFIRMED.

**Airport war on Saudi Arabia (6–13 Oct), retaliation framed against Saudi strikes on Sanaa.** KKIA Riyadh attacked on five days, hit on four (6/7, 8, 10, 11 Oct); 10 Oct: 13 dead (incl. one American, one Indian), 309 injured; GACA 20 dead/356 injured 6–11 Oct; Dammam, Abha, Najran, Jizan airports struck; Khamis Mushait air base targeted 12–13 Oct (intercepted). Saree: every Saudi airport 'unsafe' **except Mecca and Medina** (12–13 Oct — a public holy-city exemption). Method (AP, Saudi inquiry): drones first to clear a path for cruise/ballistic missiles >1,000 km. Claims on Aramco Riyadh refinery (3 Oct, fire seen by AFP), Rabigh, Shedgum, Tanajib (CLAIMED). Bukhaiti (AFP, 12–13 Oct): if the US joins, 'a swift and painful response targeting the U.S. and all its interests in the region.' Earlier: a 29-Sep drone hit Medina's Taibah power station (coalition: wreckage confirms Houthi; Houthis call it a 'lie'). — CONFIRMED (strikes); Aramco hits CLAIMED.

**THE HOUTHIS HIT RIYADH (19 Sep) AND THE US CANCELLED ITS STRIKES ON THEM (20 Sep) — the two facts are linked by Oman's channel.** Sat 19 Sep dawn: ballistic missile at Riyadh intercepted (coalition); Saree claims 'sensitive targets' in Riyadh + Aramco Yanbu; Reuters imagery/WSJ: fire at KKIA's jet-fuel storage (warhead vs debris unresolved); attempts on Bisha, Taif, Farasan, Yanbu 'thwarted'. Thu 17 Sep: first Saudi civilian death since 2022 (Taif, drone debris). Houthis claim 300 Saudi strikes in a week (unverified); Saudi 'scores of airstrikes'. Sun 20 Sep: Trump cancelled a US air campaign with bombs loading (NYT) — because the Houthis had assured Washington via Oman they would spare US and non-Saudi hulls and an official warned strikes 'would likely collapse' that understanding. Net: the group has escalated vertically against Saudi Arabia (capital, airport fuel) while buying US non-intervention with a horizontal no-attack pledge. Baghaei (Iran FM spokesman, ~17 Sep) called Houthi attribution of the 15-Sep Mecca drone 'unverified' and warned of 'false flag operations' — Tehran aligned with the Houthi denial; no coalition forensics published. (SPA; AJ; WSJ/Reuters via Fox; NYT via JPost/Daily Caller; Fox live 17 Sep) — Riyadh CONFIRMED; stand-down REPORTED (strong); Mecca attribution CLAIMED/disputed.

**TEN DAYS ON THE BAB EL-MANDEB WITHOUT A MERCHANT ATTACK — and now a public pledge: 'We are not targeting the United States, or any other nation, in the strait, with the sole exception of the Saudi enemy' (Mohamed al-Bukhaiti, political bureau, to AP by Zoom from Sanaa, Sun 20 Sep).** He said Washington 'reached out' after the coastal advance, via Oman (broker of the May 2025 US–Houthi ceasefire); The National (UAE, 20 Sep) reports Omani-mediated US–Houthi talks in Muscat at which the group pledged to spare 'American, Israeli or other commercial ships' but not Saudi vessels — 'unconfirmed by the State Department'. Trump (Fox, Sun): 'The Houthis called us… they don't want to fight with us'; 'we're in constant communication.' Operational check: no UKMTO/JMIC/Ambrey merchant incident in the southern Red Sea/Bab el-Mandeb surfaced 17–21 Sep; Kpler counted five laden SAUDI tankers exiting via Bab el-Mandeb in the week, unmolested — the pledge matches ten days of behaviour. Al-Bukhaiti's warning: any nation 'implicated in the aggression against Yemen alongside Saudi Arabia' makes it 'an international' battle. Abdul-Malik al-Houthi (TV, Mon 21 Sep, 12th anniversary of the Sanaa takeover): Saudi Arabia must 'stop the aggression and end the blockade.' Yemen theatre: WHO 680 casualties (164 dead) 13–18 Sep; IOM 129,438 displaced; Giants Brigades claim Kahbub mountains (17 Sep, disputed); 12 Houthis killed in a Marib infiltration, 13 government soldiers killed in Taiz/Lahj (AJ 19 Sep). Perim/Mocha: no change of control reported. Krieg's 14-day test: day 11, unfired (expires ~25 Sep). (AP via ABC/PBS/Euronews; The National; Fox; absence of UKMTO/JMIC incident — JMIC Sept PDF 403) — pledge CONFIRMED as statement (RHETORIC); Muscat talks REPORTED; no-attack CONFIRMED (negative operational finding).

**Six days after Perim: NO attack on any merchant vessel — Saudi or neutral — in the Bab el-Mandeb/southern Red Sea (UKMTO/Ambrey/JMIC/MARAD: none logged). The NEUTRAL-shipping trigger stays unfired; the declared non-Saudi exemption has held.** What DID happen: the Saudi coalition intercepted a drone 'south of Makkah' at 18:50 on 15 Sep and attributed it to the Houthis (al-Maliki: second attempt since 2017; holy mosques a 'red line'); the Houthis CATEGORICALLY DENY it (Saba military source; Saree: 'our operations target their oil facilities and military bases, far removed from holy places') and CLAIM a Saudi F-15 shot down over Marib with a 'locally manufactured' SAM (no Saudi confirmation, no imagery). Coalition confirms Houthi fire wounded 13 civilians in Khamis Mushait/Abha/Taif. QATAR — the mediator state — condemned the Mecca incident as 'a shameful act of aggression… a grave escalation' and separately warned closing the Bab al-Mandeb would be 'catastrophic for the entire world.' US adviser Boulos: 'freedom of navigation in the Red Sea is a red line.' Assessment: whoever launched it, the Mecca incident has cost the Houthis Qatar's neutrality. A stale item surfaced in this sweep — the Egyptian-owned Tihamah struck near Perim with 4 crew killed — is from 12 AUGUST and already in the graph; it is NOT new. (Al Jazeera; CNBC; Euronews; ToI liveblog; MARAD/UKMTO) — Interception CONFIRMED / attribution CLAIMED / non-event CONFIRMED.

**Strikes on Saudi energy: 73 wounded, Jazan refinery hit (8 Sep); Sharurah base (13 Sep).** Drone/missile wave on Abha, Khamis Mushait, Jizan, Najran — fires at oil facilities/utilities, operations halted at some energy sites, FT: Aramco Jazan hit. Amer: 'the time for committing crimes… without response has ended.' 13 Sep Saree claimed hits on Sharurah's 'weapons depots and command and control centres'; Saudi civil defence: projectile in Jazan/al-Tawwal wounded two. The Saudi-linked-vessel trigger (FIRED 21 Jul) has escalated into a land/energy campaign. (AP/NPR/ToI/The National; Al Jazeera; AP roundup — CONFIRMED)

**THE HOUTHIS HOLD THE BAB EL-MANDEB.** A week-long offensive took Mocha (Thu 10 Sep), the Greater/Lesser Hanish islands and reportedly Zuqar (11 Sep), Dhubab (Fri 11 Sep) and — after Saudi-backed Yemeni government forces withdrew — Perim/Mayun island (11 Sep), which sits in the middle of the strait and divides its two navigable channels; a Yemeni official (AFP): 'complete takeover of the Bab al-Mandab area'. Houthi forces ~20 km from the African coast. Spokesman Saree: 'maritime navigation is safe for all companies except Saudi ships' — strikes on Saudi targets to continue 'until the aggression stops and the blockade against our people is lifted'; politburo's al-Assad: navigation 'safe'. **No confirmed Houthi attack on a NON-Saudi merchant vessel since the seizure (NOT FOUND — the declared exemption is holding so far).** Counter-moves: Yemeni government claims strikes on Houthi vehicles/weapons near Mocha/Dhubab (13 Sep); Saudi air strikes on Mocha airport and Saada. MBS asked Trump for direct US strikes; Trump declined (intel/targeting only). IOM: 76,000 displaced since July, 46,000 in a week; >2,000 to Djibouti in 24h. Krieg (KCL): not a closure, but 'a dramatically stronger ability to contest, threaten and potentially deny commercial use' — 'an extraordinary shock to the global trading system'. (AP, NBC, AFP, Guardian, Al Jazeera, CBS — CONFIRMED)

The decision was framed as response to Israeli military operations in Gaza, **NOT** as response to US-Iran kinetic preparations — a subtle but consequential framing choice. **The announcement IS calibrated**: (i) targets Israel directly, not US/UK shipping; (ii) Haifa is on the Israeli MEDITERRANEAN coast, not Red Sea — 'long-distance naval blockade' of a Mediterranean port from Yemen is more rhetorical than operational; (iii) the announcement is justified by Gaza, preserving Houthi option to claim they haven't entered the Iran-US theater. **Maritime Executive headline uses scare quotes around 'blockade' precisely because it has NOT been operationalized**: no attack on a vessel attempting to dock at Haifa has been independently confirmed. Saree cited the Eilat-port blockade as precedent and claimed Eilat 'has since ceased operations' (REPORTED Houthi claim; independent maritime confirmation pending — Eilat is Red Sea-adjacent, structurally different from Haifa's Mediterranean position). Atlantic Council / Stimson analytical framing: 'targeted provocations highlight the fundamental problem with partial regional ceasefires — they merely redirect rather than resolve hostilities.' **The 'coordinated quietism' framing was a graduated-rhetoric pattern, NOT a structural restraint** — Iran's proxy network can pivot from non-attack (last 7 days) to verbal-blockade within 48 hours. **NEW trigger ADDED at 'watching'**: confirmed missile/drone aimed at Haifa-bound shipping within 14 days = action-tag upgrade to CONFIRMED ACTION; silence through Day 14 = 'rhetoric-only' tag holds. Lloyds JWC EastMed AWRP movement will be cleanest operational test — if Lloyds elevates the EastMed war-risk premium, the 'rhetoric-only' tag weakens. **The announcement lands on the same day as Trump's postponement post — re-armed proxy rhetoric overlay on the postponed kinetic axis is a Sadjadpour 'two hubris' second-order signal: Iran's proxy network reasserts deniable optionality precisely when the diplomatic axis pauses.**

recent_signals.headline: HOUTHIS RETURNED LETHALLY FOR ~72H THEN WENT QUIET: MAGIC SEAS ATTACKED 6 JUL (gunfire/RPGs/USVs, crew abandoned); **ETERNITY C SUNK BY 9 JUL — >=4 CREW DEAD, 11 HELD**; 16 YEMENI GOVT TROOPS KILLED 5 JUL; NO FURTHER SHIPPING ATTACKS 10-17 JUL (negative finding); REPORTED (Reuters chain): IRAN ASKED HOUTHIS TO CLOSE BAB EL-MANDEB **IF** US STRIKES IRANIAN ENERGY/POWER INFRASTRUCTURE — THE COCKED PISTOL

**THE BAB EL-MANDEB TRIGGER CONDITION FIRED AND THE RESPONSE DID NOT COME — the single most important negative finding of this window.** Reuters (16 Jul, three unnamed sources) reported Iran had told the Houthis to stand ready to close the Red Sea oil route IF the US struck Iranian POWER infrastructure. That condition is now satisfied on the evidence: AP confirms US strikes hit an electricity-and-desalination plant in Hormozgan; Iran's own Energy Ministry acknowledged 'attacks on power infrastructure' for the first time on 17 Jul; the national electricity CEO put grid losses at 4,200 MW across 2,000+ damaged points. **And across 17-19 Jul there is NO UKMTO or JMIC incident at Bab el-Mandeb, no attack on commercial shipping, no closure move, and no Houthi missile or drone launched at Israel.** Three live readings: (a) Tehran judges distribution networks and a desalination plant not to meet a threshold it defined as the NATIONAL GRID — most probable; (b) the instruction is held as unexpended leverage; (c) the Houthis are declining. Corroborating market evidence that closure is not imminent: the Suez Canal Authority RAISED transit surcharges from 15 Jul (laden tankers 25%->37%, dry bulk 10%->22%) — a pricing decision that only makes sense if the Authority expects volumes to HOLD. Houthi official Mohammed al-Farah said the group is prepared to shut the strait 'in coordination with Iran' — RHETORIC, no action. ~7% of global oil output transited Bab el-Mandeb in June. **SOURCING DISCIPLINE: the instruction traces to ONE Reuters story; FDD/LWJ, Haaretz, Arab News, Forbes, The Hill and Fox all amplify it. Do NOT upgrade on outlet count.** REPORTED (instruction) / CONFIRMED (non-action).

DISINFORMATION FLAGGED AND REJECTED: search engines are surfacing a 'Houthi drone hit Tel Aviv on 19 July killing one' item. Every underlying source (PBS, CBS, CBC, The National) is the **19 JULY 2024** attack. This is a date-anniversary collision and will likely recur in downstream feeds. No Houthi attack on Israel has been found since early June 2026. REJECTED — logged so the error is not re-imported.

**THE FIREWALL CRACKED — BUT SIDEWAYS, AND NOT ON THE IRAN TRIGGER.** On 20 July Houthi military spokesman **Yahya Saree** declared 'a maritime embargo against the criminal Saudi enemy, based on the equation of an eye for an eye, **effective immediately**,' citing Saudi Arabia's 'blockade of our ports and airports' and the strike on **Sanaa airport**, and calling for 'general mobilisation.' **READ THE CASUS BELLI PRECISELY, BECAUSE IT IS NOT THE ONE WE WERE WATCHING.** This is NOT a closure of Bab el-Mandeb to world shipping, NOT an attack on Israel, and **NOT framed as retaliation for US strikes on Iran at all.** The chain is Yemen-internal: Yemen's recognised government struck Sanaa airport to stop an Iranian aircraft landing -> the Houthis blamed SAUDI ARABIA -> **on 13 July the Houthis fired ballistic missiles at Abha airport, the first Houthi-Saudi exchange in years** -> Hodeidah fighting flared -> the blockade declaration. **THE REUTERS TRIGGER STILL HAS NOT FIRED ITS PREDICTED RESPONSE: 14 days after the US struck Iranian power infrastructure, no Bab el-Mandeb closure.** A source close to the group says missiles and drones are deployed near the strait '**awaiting the order**.' The order has not come. **THE COMMERCIAL TARGET IS PRECISE: Bab el-Mandeb throughput is UP — 7.4m bpd in June vs 4.2m a year earlier — because Saudi Arabia has been routing crude across the East-West Petroline to Yanbu, where loadings average ~4m bpd against ~973k a year earlier. The Houthi declaration is aimed squarely at the one workaround keeping Gulf oil flowing.** ISW: Iran is 'trying to expand the geographical scope of its conflict with the United States to the Red Sea,' and notes **NO Houthi attack on shipping since 7 July** — the embargo is enforced by radio turn-back orders only. Other side: Saudi MFA condemned 'the so-called military spokesperson of the terrorist Houthi militia'; **Qatar publicly backed Riyadh**; the UN urged de-escalation; MEE reports **Saudi Arabia mulling military escalation** — the first sign of a Gulf state considering kinetic counter-escalation this cycle. CONFIRMED (declaration) / RHETORIC (no enforcement).

**THE FRONT CRACKED TO 'DECLARATION WITH EFFECT' — but NO kinetic strike (Day ~15).** The Saudi-shipping embargo (declared 20 Jul) is enforced by WARNING EMAIL AND RADIO ONLY — 'Houthis warn shipping companies to avoid Saudi ports, email shows' (Reuters). **Effect is real but non-kinetic: THREE tankers carrying Saudi crude made U-turns in the Red Sea, AIS-confirmed** (Reuters, WaPo). NO confirmed missile/drone hit on any ship — checked specifically. **Bab el-Mandeb is NOT closed**, and the 16 July Reuters 'close the strait if the US hits Iranian power' order STILL has not fired its predicted kinetic response (~15 days). Counter-signal: a sanctioned Iranian rocket-fuel vessel entered the Red Sea FREELY post-blockade (TradeWinds) — Iranian shipping transits while Saudi cargo turns back, i.e. the embargo is TARGETED COERCION of Riyadh, not a general closure. Saudi Arabia rejected the blockade and 'vows to protect shipping'; Trump threatened to strike the Houthis; Saudi loadings -36%. CONFIRMED (declaration + AIS turn-backs) / RHETORIC (no kinetic).

**THE RED SEA FIREWALL WENT KINETIC — the first confirmed Houthi ship-strike of the campaign.** After ~15 days enforcing the Saudi-shipping embargo by email/radio (three AIS turn-backs), the Houthis struck TWO Saudi crude tankers — **Encelia and Layla** — with missiles and drones; ONE SET ABLAZE; all crew reported safe. This is CONFIRMED, not one-side: **Saudi state news (SPA) confirmed a Saudi-owned vessel was targeted, and UKMTO/UK confirmed a tanker on fire** — corroborated across Reuters, NYT, Al Jazeera, Seatrade, CNBC, Splash247. The ship-strike count resets to Day 1. READ THE CALIBRATION AND LIMITS PRECISELY: tankers not warships, crew safe, no mass casualty; **Bab el-Mandeb is NOT closed — ISW counts 30 vessels transiting on 22 Jul, down from 64 the prior day (a HALVING, not a closure)**; NO Saudi military counterstrike on Yemen reported; and a sanctioned Iranian rocket-fuel vessel continues to transit the Red Sea FREELY — this is TARGETED COERCION of Saudi cargo, not a general shut strait. Houthi HOCC broadened the language to 'all vessels at Saudi ports prohibited.' Trump threatened to deploy heavy bombers against the Houthis (REPORTED, not executed). CONFIRMED (kinetic strike).
